summary: Historical analogue constructed in 2026. WBA is used to study value traps and dividend traps where the earnings denominator deteriorates faster than the valuation multiple compresses. No contemporaneous TRQuant recommendation is asserted.
candidate_lessons: Low P/E and high dividend yield are not independent evidence of value.
A dividend cut can reveal that prior yield was compensation for deteriorating economics rather than mispricing.
Normalize FCF after required reinvestment and obligations before calling a stock cheap.
